title: Group slams ‘reckless’ displacement of street dwellers for Asean Summit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A group advocating for people in street dwelling situations (PSDS) on Friday criticized the government’s clearing and beautification operations ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit on Nov. 15 to 17. According to Kaagapay ng mga Sandigan ng Masang Nasa Kalsada (Kasama Ka) Executive Director Gil Espenido, the driving out of street dwellers was “reckless” and deprives vendors and informal workers of their livelihoods. “These anti-poor measures to please the nation’s visiting dignitaries are a natural extension of the crime of the government against the PSDS and the poor,” he said.
